title: Harnessing urban analytics and machine learning for sustainable urban development: A multidimensional framework for modeling environmental impacts of urbanization in Saudi Arabia
sensors: DMSP-OLS Nighttime Lights Time Series V4
key_result: Built-up land grew from 0.067% to 0.14% of Saudi Arabia (1987-2022), mean soil moisture fell from 15.76% to 14.02%, mean PM2.5 rose from 44.25 to 73.36 ug/m3, and PCA gave the highest PC1 loadings to PM2.5 (0.94), UTFVI (0.92) and NO2 (0.88).

method_details.platform: Google Earth Engine for all datasets; regression in ArcGIS Pro
method_details.landsat: Cloud-free summer Landsat 5 and Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance, VNIR/SWIR 30 m, TIR resampled to 30 m by cubic convolution; Landsat 8 TIR as surface temperature product
method_details.classification: Object-based image classification: graph-based minimal spanning tree segmentation, spectral/spatial/texture features, stacked autoencoder (SAE) or stacked denoising autoencoder (SDAE); classes urban, water bodies, vegetation, bare land; ROC AUC accuracy above 90%
method_details.gravity_center: Xt = sum(Xi * Cti) / sum(Cti); Yt = sum(Yi * Cti) / sum(Cti)
method_details.gravity_shift_angle: alpha(t+1) = arctan((Y(t+1) - Yt) / (X(t+1) - Xt)), angle from east
method_details.ndbi: (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR); five manual classes (no, very less, moderate, dense, very dense built-up), breaks not reported
method_details.utfvi: (LSTmax - LSTmin) / (LSTmax + LSTmin) as printed (Eq. 11); not the per-pixel (Ts - Tmean)/Ts form; no UTFVI class breaks reported
method_details.soil_moisture: NASA GLDAS-2 soil moisture, 2002-2022 (units reported as %)

air_quality.source: NASA GMAO GEOS-CF (Goddard Earth Observing System Composition Forecast), 1-hour dataset; not Sentinel-5P

night_light.source: DMSP-OLS Nighttime Lights Time Series Version 4 (NOAA); Fig. 14 credits Earth Observation Group, Payne Institute for Public Policy

method_details.regression: EP = b0 + b1 * UE + e for EVI, NDBI, MNDWI, NDISI, soil moisture, LST, UTFVI, PM2.5, CH4, SO2, NO2, CO, NTL; normality and linearity checked first; UE is the independent variable

pca.input: matrix of observations x EPs, mean-centered by column
pca.decomposition: eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the covariance matrix
